[raw subtype: neurognathostomiasis] C: H&E of human brain tissue showing dense eosinophilic inflammatory infiltrate concentrated around a blood vessel (BV), the hallmark inflammatory response of gnathostomiasis; caption and in-text explicitly attribute these findings to the brain biopsy of this gnathostomiasis patient.
